evidence.t: Burn from 2021 (fire G61381), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 15 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 130 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: M.U.s 7-38 and 7-39. Closed Year Round. Synopsis map 7-1/23.
Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Finlay River. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-59/23.

plan: Drive: from Bear Lake, about 129 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 56.57835, -125.40808, pull off on Swannell Ml (paved road). Map links below.
Walk: 27 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 2,685 m, about 800 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m SW of the spot at 740 m (56.78539, -125.62381). Water: unnamed wetland 140 m SE (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-39, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2023-09-20, closures 2026-10-16.
